According to the image, the longer 25 meters is the entire bottom side of the rectangle, and is also the lower base of the trapezoid; the shorter 15 meters is the upper base of the trapezoid in the middle of the top. Therefore, the total horizontal length occupied by the two triangles at the top of the rectangle is 25 - 15 = 10 meters. The two triangles are congruent, so the horizontal right-angle side length of each triangle is 10 ÷ 2 = 5 meters. Each triangle is an isosceles right triangle, so its vertical right-angle side is also 5 meters, and this is also the height of the rectangle. The total area of the two flower beds is 2 × (1/2 × 5 × 5) = 25 square meters. The area of the entire rectangular yard is 25 × 5 = 125 square meters. Therefore the fraction of the yard occupied by the flower beds is 25/125 = 1/5.
